title: Mere baba dekh
body:
zahra ye bain karti thi qabre rasool par
zulm o sitam ki hadh hui baba batool par
dar ko gira ke todi hai zahra ki phasliyan
lamha ba lamha jaati hai zahra ki haye jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyan tooti hui hai dard kab seh payegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap bhi royenge baba dekh kar chehra mera
neel hai rukhsaar ab tak aankh hai meri siyah
zakhm jab sayli ki zehra aap ko dikhlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha dar ko giraya kis tarha maara mujhe
kis tarha dewaar o dar may haye hai peesa mujhe
har sitam beti tumhari aap ko batlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab ye socha tha musalman is khadar gir jayenge
mujhko darbar e sitam may be-khata bulwayenge
ek siddiqa ko ummat is tarha jhutlayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne bachon ke maara kya bataun baba jaan
dard se tadpti bahot hai saamne bachon ke maa
yaad is manzar ki inko har ghadi rulwayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko jab awaaz denge mere bache be-amaan
tod kar bande kafan ko aayegi mazlooma maa
apne bachon se galay phir fatema lag jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
daagh sayli ke kisi ko baba dikhlaati nahi
phasliyan tooti magar hyder ko batlaati nahi
dard pehlu ka ye zehra qabr tak le jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jeete ji hyder ke mujhpar har sitam hota raha
toota ye pehlu kabhi to taziyana bhi laga
hashr tak ghurbat ali ki khoon bhi rulwayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne tukde karega aap ki zaalim sanad
mujhko degi chunte chunte is tarha ka gham sanad
chand lamho may zaeefa fatema ho jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
danish o rehaan ro kar bas karo har dam dua
naukri tasleem kar le kaash bibi fatema
bil yaqeen aisa hua to aakhirat ban jayegi
mere baba dekh lena fatema mar jayegi
phasliyan tooti hui hai...
author: Danish Mirza
